finding: Owner idempotence retained only issued native shots. A refused serial left no receipt and could execute if a duplicate arrived after its task/safety gate changed. Rejection callbacks matched token/owner but not the current shot serial.
implementation: Separate one last-refused token/serial/signature/time receipt; issued-shot receipt semantics unchanged.
Request classification chooses the highest observed issued/refused serial for the same token. Duplicate, stale and conflicting payloads do not fire or reject a newer pending request.
Refusal publication requires current local battery and exact current fire token. Old token refusals cannot overwrite a successor refusal receipt.
Rejection reply carries finite positive integral serial; server requires exact pending mission serial plus existing token/owner/phase checks before mutation.
Two fixed receipt lookups, no queue scan, worker, timer or native firing command added.

validation.provenance: Unsigned development build: baseline+intended edits+retained unrelated dirty state.

limits: Source/static contracts are not actual SQF/message-order execution.
Public receipts do not guarantee ordered replication to a new owner; delayed HC transfer and physical no-duplicate firing remain unverified.
A refusal is not firing evidence; actual shell event remains separate.
Audits PAUSED; no push/merge/publication; no parity or percentage change.
